VIEW DETAILS
Frequently Asked Question
What is DishTV?
DishTV is India's leading Direct-to-Home (DTH) service provider. With DishTV, you get crystal-clear picture, high-definition audio, and access to hundreds of TV channels — from entertainment and sports to news and kids’ programs — directly on your TV.
Why choose DishTV?
Affordable Packages: Customize your own pack and pay only for the channels you watch.
Easy Installation: Get Dish TV set-up quickly at your home with a simple phone call or online booking.
Recharge Anytime: Top-up or pay your bills online, through our app or website.
Hassle-free Customer Support: Our team is available 24/7 to help you resolve any issues promptly. · Add-Ons and Services: Enjoy additional services like DishTV Smart+,
multi-TV connection,
and video-on-demand.
How DishTV works?
DishTV uses a small satellite dish installed at your home to receive signals directly from the satellite in space. The signals are routed through your set-top box and displayed on your TV in real time.
Who should set DishTV?
New TV Viewers: If you’re setting up your first TV connection at home.
Relocating Families: If you’re shifting and want to transfer your connection easily.
Existing Customers: If you want to add a secondary connection in another room or a vacation home.
DishTV Product Range — Designed To Suit Your Viewing Experience
At DishTV, we bring you a range of products tailored to match your lifestyle and preferences. Whatever your TV needs, we have something for you:
Dish HD
— Experience stunning picture clarity and rich audio with our high-definition set-top box.
DishSMRT HUB
— Transform your TV into a Smart TV with DishSMRT HUB. Stream content from popular apps alongside your satellite TV.
DISHTV SMART+ STB Dongle
— An easy way to add smart functionality to your existing set-top box, letting you enjoy a world of entertainment on-demand.
DISHTV SMART+ TV Key
— Compact, plug-and-play TV Key that lets you stream apps and video-on-demand directly on your TV.
DishTV Universal Remote
— Take control of all your devices with a single universal remote — simple, convenient, and designed to make your TV experience effortless.
